h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bangalore

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bangalore

c: Bangalore's mild weather is good news for an open gym. People here can exercise outdoors through most of the year, including the summer months. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bangalore for apartment complexes, tech parks and corporate campuses, schools, colleges and the parks around the city's lakes. We make the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 870 km away, and deliver it by road.

Most of our Bangalore enquiries come from large apartment complexes, where the clubhouse gym is small and residents want something outdoors. An open gym along the internal jogging track or beside the landscaped garden gets used by residents of every age. The city's main rains come from June to October, with heavy showers in September and October. Plan a firm, drained base, and keep machines away from spots where water runs off the podium. Tell us your layout and we will place the stations so they sit well with the landscaping.

richText.heading: Open gyms for apartment complexes and tech parks

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 870 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply open gym equipment to a Bangalore apartment complex?
items.a: Yes. Share the site plan or photos of the area. We suggest machines, send a layout drawing and quote, and install after manufacturing at our Vasai factory.

items.q: Can the machines go on a podium or terrace?
items.a: Often, using self-standing installation on a firm, level slab. Ask your structural consultant to confirm the slab, and we will advise on the base for each machine.

items.q: Do you work with architects and garden designers?
items.a: Yes. We can work from your architect's plan and mark each station and its clear space on it, so the gym fits the planting and paths.
